question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Blistering**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Chilly** (Option 2).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"blistering"** means extremely hot or severe in intensity. It is often used to describe weather, criticism, or speed. (अत्यधिक गर्म या तीव्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The athletes competed under the blistering sun during the marathon.
 
 
• **"Chilly" **refers to something unpleasantly cold or cool in temperature, which is the opposite of "blistering." (ठंडा)
 
 
• **Example:** The chilly breeze made everyone pull on their jackets.
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate antonym of **'blistering'** is **'chilly'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Chilly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scorching **(झुलसाने वाला): Refers to extremely hot temperatures, similar in meaning to "blistering."
 
 
• **Example:** The scorching heat in the desert made it difficult to travel during the day.
 
 
 
• **Burning **(जलता हुआ): Indicates intense heat or flame, also similar in meaning to "blistering."
 
 
• **Example:** The burning fire spread quickly through the dry forest.
 
 
 
• **Incendiary** (आग लगाने वाला): Refers to something designed to cause fires or something inflammatory in nature.
 
 
• **Example:** The politician’s incendiary remarks caused widespread protests.
